title: Doha NO2 drop -> short LHA.DE
hypothesis: R2 | [fuel-airspace-losers] Doha CAMS NO2 5d mean falling more than 15 pct vs 20d mean flags Gulf flight-cancellation waves (-); trade short LHA.DE 4d at 3d lag [airquality.doha.cams_no2 -> finance.LHA.DE.log_return]
message: Weak: Doha NO2 z>1 short LHA.DE 2d gives 46 trades, hit 50 pct, avg +0.43 pct, OOS 16 trades hit 56 pct, but validity 0 / permutation null (Bonferroni p=1.0); not tradeable as-is

trade_idea.entry_rule: airquality.doha.cams_no2 rolling_zscore_20d > 1 at close -> short LHA next session
trade_idea.exit_rule: close after 2 trading days (no overlapping entries)
trade_idea.caveats: Backtest on daily closes, no costs/slippage; few independent regimes; signal and target may share the war as common cause.

followup_hypothesis: R2 | [fuel-airspace-losers] Null control: Doha CAMS NO2 20d z-score above 1 vs Gulf-neutral cruise operator CCL (-); if the Doha NO2 -> LHA.DE short edge (hit 50 pct, validity 0) is real it should vanish here; trade short CCL 2d at 2d lag [airquality.doha.cams_no2 -> finance.CCL.log_return] (parent: R2-0061)
